The camera wearer is on a narrow trail surrounded by low vegetation. Another hiker or guide is very close—roughly 1–2 meters ahead and to the right—facing along the trail rather than toward the wearer. They are not blocking each other’s path. The wearer already has a compact camera within reach and is raising/adjusting it near the plants, making photographing the trail vegetation the most natural next action.
